subject: Test donation question 2
originalBody:
Hello,

I would like to make a donation, how do I do that?

Thanks!
draftBody:
Hello,

Thank you for your interest in supporting Panzi Foundation! The easiest way to give is through our donation page at https://panzifoundation.org/donate/ — you can set up a one-time or monthly gift, choose your preferred currency, and pay by credit/debit card, Google Pay, PayPal, or bank transfer (ACH).

If you prefer to send a check or money order, please mail it to: Panzi Foundation, 5185 MacArthur Blvd. NW, #708, Washington, DC 20016, USA. Please include your email address so we can send your receipt.

We also gratefully accept gifts of stock. If you have any questions or run into any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out — we're happy to help!

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team
